announcement.title: 📱 Smartphone Widget v3.0.0
announcement.content:
Smartphone Widget v3.0.0 lets players keep using their phones without a connected GM while the Foundry world stays running. Requires GlitchSmith Library 0.13.2 or later.

  • Messages, Social, contacts, gallery, notes, calendar, and phone customization save and sync without a GM. Calls, banking, prepared Gacha pools, and multiplayer Checkers also work.
  • Add custom image emoji, including animated GIFs. GMs can share emoji with every phone. Preview emoji in the message draft and leave reactions on messages.
  • Create group polls with single or multiple choices and optional anonymous voting. Open ongoing polls or the pinned-message list from the top of a conversation.
  • Save messages to Notes, search a conversation's full history, and browse its shared photos. Return to the original message from each view.
  • Send money from Contacts or request payments in a conversation. Group requests support individual amounts, splitting a total, or one member paying.
  • Changing a phone number keeps its direct messages and read status. Incoming updates preserve drafts and scrolling.

Scheduled Social publishing and world time controls still require a GM. File uploads and saved image edits require Foundry's Upload Files permission.
